name: Counseling
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital importance of seeking godly counsel for wisdom and safety, warning that without it, people fall into folly and failure. The Proverbs passages reveal that wise counsel brings health, establishes purposes, and prevents contention caused by pride. True understanding involves drawing out counsel thoughtfully, contrasting the fool who trusts only his own way. Thus, counseling is portrayed as a necessary means by which believers gain wisdom and avoid the pitfalls of self-reliance.
